In today's video I'll be  reviewing the gels I have used for retwisting my locs and braiding hair.Some of the loc gels I have used have been amazing, and others loc gels haven't been that great when I have used them to retwist my locs. I have experienced build up when retwisting with some of the loc gels from when I had starter locs. I have suffered product build up as a result of using loc gels that do not work for my locs when I retwisting with some of these products. The ones that I have found, I realise that a little does go a long way to prevent product build up and flaking on my locs and on my starter locs when I retwist. One advice I would give to anyone starting their loc journey is to ensure that you fully research on the best loc gels to you to prevent product build up. Honestly prevention is better than cure. I wish I had done this earlier myself, I would've saved myself a lot of headache on my loc journey when dealing with product build up and loc gels that do not work or give me a good hold. 
Once you've found a loc gel that give you a good loc hold and no build up when doing a loc retwist, sis/bro.... stick with it lol. Honestly because once you incorporate this with some cute loc styles it's a game changer! It makes the journey just that much more enjoyable. 

Whether you're starting with loc, medium or long locs. This loc journey is also about enjoying each and every stage so why not start it with loc products/ gels that actually work well with your hair.  Keep me posted on how the starter loc baby stage is going too if you're starting. If you've been loc'd for a while, how's it going? Have you suffered from product build up from loc gels? Do you use them or opt out of them entirely?
